I got myself a bottle of water each day and I drank it while I watched TV.  Drinking enough water is a must, or the body can't function well and it can't lose weight.  I started walking a little more each day.  To the park, to the store, to the neighbor's.  I started eating a salad for lunch, or at least that is what I called it.  But it was always just a piece of chicken, maybe a little of this, a little of that.  And then, I started doing it.  I started going for a run.  For 10 minutes.  Then for 20 minutes.  And then for 30 minutes.  Now I'm going for 45 minutes. 

I also started to eat breakfast.  Every morning.  And I started eating better at night too.  I started not eating any more junk food.  I didn't eat any more ice cream.  And I started eating more fruits.  A lot of fruit.

Our eyes have been burning with eye strain as we stare at screens for hours on end. This isn't the kind of education I was hoping for.
